metamagic.name: Careful Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 sorcery point and choose a number of those creatures...

metamagic.name: Distant Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of the spell.

metamagic.name: Empowered Spell
metamagic.desc: When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.

metamagic.name: Extended Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

metamagic.name: Heightened Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

metamagic.name: Quickened Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

metamagic.name: Seeking Spell
metamagic.desc: If you make an attack roll for a spell and miss, you can spend 2 sorcery points to reroll the d20, and you must use the new roll.

metamagic.name: Subtle Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

metamagic.name: Transmuted Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that deals a type of damage from the following list, you can spend 1 sorcery point to change that damage type to one of the other listed types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder.

metamagic.name: Twinned Spell
metamagic.desc: When you cast a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1...

invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
invocations.desc: When you cast eldritch blast, add your Charisma modifier to the damage it deals on a hit.

invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
invocations.desc: You can cast mage armor on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Ascendant Step
invocations.desc: You can cast levitate on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Aspect of the Moon
invocations.desc: You no longer need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep by any means. To gain the benefits of a long rest, you can spend all 8 hours doing light activity, such as reading your Book of Shadows and keeping watch.

invocations.name: Bond of the Talisman
invocations.prereq: 12th level, Pact of the Talisman feature
invocations.desc: While someone else is wearing your talisman, you can use your action to teleport to the unoccupied space closest to them, provided the two of you are on the same plane of existence. The wearer of your talisman can do...

invocations.name: Chains of Carceri
invocations.prereq: 15th level, Pact of the Chain feature
invocations.desc: You can cast hold monster at will – targeting a celestial, fiend, or elemental – without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a long rest before you can use this invocation on the same creature...

invocations.name: Cloak of Flies
invocations.desc: As a bonus action, you can surround yourself with a magical aura that looks like buzzing flies. The aura extends 5 feet from you in every direction, but not through total cover. It lasts until you're incapacitated or...

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.desc: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

invocations.name: Dreadful Word
invocations.desc: You can cast confusion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
invocations.desc: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell.

invocations.name: Eldritch Sight
invocations.desc: You can cast detect magic at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
invocations.prereq: 5th level, Pact of the Blade feature

invocations.name: Eldritch Spear
invocations.desc: When you cast eldritch blast, its range is 300 feet.

invocations.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
invocations.desc: You can read all writing.

invocations.name: Far Scribe
invocations.prereq: 5th level, Pact of the Tome feature
invocations.desc: A new page appears in your Book of Shadows. With your permission, a creature can use its action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your proficiency bonus.

invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
invocations.desc: You can cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
invocations.desc: You can use your action to touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can use your action on...

invocations.name: Ghostly Gaze
invocations.desc: As an action, you gain the ability to see through solid objects to a range of 30 feet. Within that range, you have darkvision if you don't already have it. This special sight lasts for 1 minute or until your...

invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
invocations.desc: You can breathe underwater, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

invocations.name: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
invocations.desc: Whenever you regain hit points while your familiar is within 100 feet of you, treat any dice rolled to determine the hit points you regain as having rolled their maximum value for you.

invocations.name: Gift of the Protectors
invocations.prereq: 9th level, Pact of the Tome feature
invocations.desc: A new page appears in your Book of Shadows. With your permission, a creature can use its action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your proficiency bonus.

invocations.name: Grasp of Hadar
invocations.desc: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast, you can move that creature in a straight line 10 feet closer to yourself.

invocations.name: Improved Pact Weapon
invocations.desc: You can use any weapon you summon with your Pact of the Blade feature as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells.

invocations.name: Investment of the Chain Master

invocations.name: Lance of Lethargy
invocations.desc: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with your eldritch blast, you can reduce that creature's speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

invocations.name: Lifedrinker
invocations.prereq: 12th level, Pact of the Blade feature
invocations.desc: When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

invocations.name: Maddening Hex
invocations.prereq: 5th level, hex spell or a warlock feature that curses
invocations.desc: As a bonus action, you cause a psychic disturbance around the target cursed by your hex spell or by a warlock feature of yours, such as Hexblade's Curse and Sign of Ill Omen. When you do so, you deal psychic damage to...

invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
invocations.desc: You can cast disguise self at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Master of Myriad Forms
invocations.desc: You can cast alter self at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Minions of Chaos
invocations.desc: You can cast conjure elemental once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Mire the Mind
invocations.desc: You can cast slow once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Misty Visions
invocations.desc: You can cast silent image at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

invocations.name: One with Shadows
invocations.desc: When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible until you move or take an action or a reaction.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
invocations.desc: You can cast jump at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Protection of the Talisman
invocations.prereq: 7th level, Pact of the Talisman feature
invocations.desc: When the wearer of your talisman fails a saving throw, they can add a d4 to the roll, potentially turning the save into a success. This benefit can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and all...

invocations.name: Rebuke of the Talisman
invocations.desc: When the wearer of your talisman is hit by an attacker you can see within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to deal psychic damage to the attacker equal to your proficiency bonus and push it up to 10 feet away...

invocations.name: Relentless Hex
invocations.prereq: 7th level, hex spell or a warlock feature that curses

invocations.name: Repelling Blast
invocations.desc: When you hit a creature with eldritch blast, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

invocations.name: Sculptor of Flesh
invocations.desc: You can cast polymorph once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Shroud of Shadow
invocations.desc: You can cast invisibility at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Sign of Ill Omen
invocations.desc: You can cast bestow curse once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Thief of Five Fates
invocations.desc: You can cast bane once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
invocations.prereq: 5th level, Pact of the Blade feature
invocations.desc: You can attack with your pact weapon twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

invocations.name: Tomb of Levistus
invocations.desc: As a reaction when you take damage, you can entomb yourself in ice, which melts away at the end of your next turn. You gain 10 temporary hit points per warlock level, which take as much of the triggering damage as...

invocations.name: Trickster's Escape
invocations.desc: You can cast freedom of movement once on yourself without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Undying Servitude
invocations.desc: You can cast animate dead without using a spell slot. Once you do so, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a long rest.

invocations.name: Visions of Distant Realms
invocations.desc: You can cast arcane eye at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Voice of the Chain Master
invocations.desc: You can communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through your familiar's senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. Additionally, while perceiving through your familiar's senses, you can...

invocations.name: Whispers of the Grave
invocations.desc: You can cast speak with dead at will, without expending a spell slot.

invocations.name: Witch Sight
invocations.desc: You can see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion or transmutation magic while the creature is within 30 feet of you and within line of sight.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Blade
pact_boons.desc: You can use your action to create a pact weapon in your empty hand. You can choose the form that this melee weapon takes each time you create it. You are proficient with it while you wield it. This weapon counts as...

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Chain
pact_boons.desc: You learn the find familiar spell and can cast it as a ritual. The spell doesn't count against your number of spells known.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Tome
pact_boons.desc: Your patron gives you a grimoire called a Book of Shadows. When you gain this feature, choose three cantrips from any class's spell list (the three needn't be from the same list). While the book is on your person, you...

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Talisman
pact_boons.desc: Your patron gives you an amulet, a talisman that can aid the wearer when the need is great. When the wearer fails an ability check, they can add a d4 to the roll, potentially turning the roll into a success. This...
